caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with three drawers, each featuring two metal pull handles with a dark color and small circular backplates. The chest has a medium-brown wood finish, with visible grain patterns throughout its surfaces. The top of the chest is bordered at the rear and sides by an elevated, curved backsplash with scroll-like ends, and horizontal dowels connect the upper portions of the side elements to the central back panel. The chest stands on four short legs, with decorative cutouts along the lower front and side edges. The drawing is rendered on a light beige background, and the artist's signature "berry king" along with "K. C. MO." is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Walnut Wash Stand
